summary.goal: Provide comprehensive editing for step details including acceptance criteria and gates
summary.context: Steps are the core content of plans. Users need to edit title, description, criteria, owner roles, and gates. Complex edits expand in place rather than opening modals.

acceptance_criteria.description: Step card shows title, scope, dependencies count
Click expands step to show all fields
Owner role selector with common roles
Dependency display shows what this step depends on
Drag-drop to reorder steps within scope

plan_remediation.reason: Audit found StepEditor component exists but not integrated; missing features

steps.title: Add steps support to frontend API
steps.description: Update updatePlan() in api/plans.ts to accept steps parameter. Backend already supports PUT /plans/:id with steps array.

acceptance_criteria.description: updatePlan(planId, { steps: Step[] }) sends steps to backend
Type signature: updatePlan(planId: string, data: { goal?: string; context?: string; steps?: Step[] })

steps.title: Integrate StepEditor into PlanEditorPage
steps.description: Replace read-only <li> step rendering with StepEditor component. Wire up onUpdate and onDelete handlers to call updatePlan API.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanEditorPage imports and renders StepEditor for each step
